headline: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents complete Minecraft’s main survival objective in one 27-hour run
summary: An Oct 15 arXiv preprint reports that four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents completed Minecraft’s main survival objective by defeating the Ender Dragon in one randomly generated Java Edition 1.20.4 world on Easy difficulty. The agents coordinated through in-game chat and shared memory, wrote 2,783 programs, and reached the win 27 hours 14 minutes after the first program; the paper says no human intervened. The authors report that the server log recorded the final advancement, and describe 605 deaths and six server restarts. This is a single author-reported run, not a reliability result. Mineflayer exposed nearby world state, including information unavailable to a human player, and supplied pathfinding; prior knowledge of Minecraft was not removed.
